CMR.note: A dedicated power plant is planned beside a data centre not yet built; nothing in service.
The Dibamba two-hectare data centre is planned, with no builder, financier or timeline named; none in service.
Port authority says the planned data centre would keep hosted data under Cameroonian sovereignty, but no government data, plan or rule is stated.
The Port Autonome de Douala data centre is planned, not in service.
